traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are implemented and verified. The valid-annotation-format rule now uses normalizeCommentLine and isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine to maintain line boundaries, detect any non-traceability JSDoc tags as termination points, and only treat non-@ lines as continuations of @story/@req values. Comprehensive tests explicitly tied to this story cover traceability annotations before, after, and interleaved with JSDoc tags, multi-line annotation values followed by JSDoc tags, and the original false-positive scenario. Documentation has been updated with a clear JSDoc coexistence section. The full Jest suite passes, indicating backward compatibility and correct behavior across existing scenarios. Therefore this story is fully implemented.
